name: hudline
description: Claude Code status line for context usage, remaining quota, and cumulative input/output tokens with cache-read and thinking shares. Customizable, zero dependencies.
author: Lawrence (huijoson)

scripts.typecheck: test -f plugins/pixel-hud/.claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json || { echo 'typecheck: plugins/pixel-hud/.claude-plugin/types/ is missing (the engine generates it); load the mod once with `claude --plugin-dir plugins/pixel-hud`, or copy types/ from a checkout that has it' >&2; exit 1; } && npm exec --yes --package typescript@5.9.3 -- tsc -p plugins/pixel-hud/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm test && claude plugin validate plugins/pixel-hud && claude plugin test plugins/pixel-hud && npm run typecheck
